notes.title: Surfers Code Release Announcement
notes.notes: [p]By now you know of the perpetual motion life force, and the clones and the self returning surfboards, but have you surfed the lighthouse wave? Unlocked the temple wave and it's mystery? What is happening at the campground? and the Quarry? why are all these sharks around but they aren't biting me? Now you can explore all the islands by boat, jet ski, and land to find more boards, unlock more breaks, and discover all the mysteries of Surfers Code. Do they? Explore, get on the leader boards, try new boards and other players while your surfing gets better and better.[/p][p]Surfers Code the whole enchilada available now.[/p][p]Play, surf, adventure, save the world, and review it for other adventurers.[/p][p]This Open World Non-Linear Adventure Surf Game Awaits your Arrival.[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Huge Graphics Update To Demo and Main Game
notes.notes: [p]Both the Free Demo and unreleased version have been upgraded by improving the overall lighting making it more immersive and one step closer to a cheap, uh I mean, inexpensive AAA title. Of course it's not that good, but the update makes the islands and places to visit that much cooler looking, which makes the overall feel seem much better.[/p][p][/p][p]Controls for the land player have been a little weird, say most testers and me too. So I spent a lot of time tweaking and improving the controls. This is the third major iteration of the controls for controlling the player on land, and this is by far the best so far. Sure he runs sideways funny but don't worry you have complete control of turning, looking, and walking making it way easier to get around and just play the game without fighting the camera and player movement.[/p][p][/p][p]The jet ski is smooth and fast on the water and was given a bit of zing in the close up camera view where the ski movement feels more, just, cool, as you turn and slide between rocks and docks.[/p][p][/p][p]The release is scheduled for Sept 2 2025 so wishlist it today so it gets some exposure on Steam and you will also get a reminder for the release. If you played the demo and didn't wishlist it please wishlist it because that is the main thing Steam uses to recommend it to other players. Thanks.[/p][p][/p][p]Join the discord and social medias for the game, links are on the store page.[/p]

notes.title: Demo and Game-Controller Update- Intuitive and Flexible Controls to Explore Land
notes.notes: [p]Controllers have been improved once again. This time, there is good flow as the camera follows, while being able to look around when stopped and move more easily, since you will go how you are facing.[/p][p]The update has been loaded to the main game and demo as well.[/p][p]This update is probably the biggest improvement in an update for while, so check it out and let me know what you think.[/p][p]There are also many many polished improvements which, if when working as expected, will go unnoticed making a smooth and enjoyable adventure experience.[/p][p]Coins are slightly easier to get and the more difficult ones to find give a bigger reward, to go find the pirates and get them their coins back and try out the two big wave breaks at that part of the islands.[/p]

notes.title: Open World Explore and Discover
notes.notes: [p]The land controls have been updated so the player can look around while playing and will not turn in the direction of the camera. Hopefully this is satisfactory to new players. Players seem to get up and surfing really good now, however, the concept of surfing eludes non surfers still. To learn more about surfing go to the surf school and surf club for advanced tips. Everything that will help is there, however, surfing is it's own beast and it's best to learn by doing and trying to copy the surfers in the videos.[/p][p]Explore as you surf new breaks. [/p][p]Follow the points of interest labeled on the maps to get to the places on the island where the stories and inhabitants are located to understand the secrets of the islands.[/p]

notes.title: An Adventure Game With Surfing - Improved Land Play
notes.notes: [p]Main new feature is that you can look around without rotating your player. This has been requested and was implemented so that you can control the player better when on land and look around when walking. Should be more in line with typical 3rd person game controls.[/p][p]Also updated the animations for turning and idle to be more cool.[/p][p]Made some minor quality of life changes too.[/p][p]If you get to the big trees with the bridge there is a sign so you know to find a map.[/p][p]There is a treasure chest on the volcano so you get something if you go there.[/p][p][/p]

Surfers Code Demo has been updated with easier to use camera controls, and the waves have some subtle tube riding improvements. Higher waves scores will be easier to obtain so keep your rank on the leader boards if you are already there.

Added a shark area and a boar area. Get chased by pigs and attacked by sharks. 
Another surfboard has been added for you to find.

If you like the demo remember to wish list the game.

notes.title: March Update Cameras Are Easier To Use
notes.notes:
Main change to this update is that the cameras have been adjusted to follow the player better and should make it easier to play on land and while surfing. The manual use and control of the cameras are still good and useful but for starting out it should be way easier to play on land and on sea even without controlling the camera. 
Tip try the big wave board - gun - on the waves that are activated by collecting 200 coins and visiting Captain Jack O Neil. Best surfed using the pro cam, especially the dry reef one.

notes.title: The Greatest Surfing Adventure Game of All Time - A Worthy Update Try It
notes.notes: I've always liked the surfing even though it's pretty hard to get the hang of for non surfers. Trying and learning can be fun too depending on your attitude. Now, with the new update I really like the exploration too. Collecting coins is fun and has a purpose, and there are lots of quirky characters and wildlife to encounter while exploring. Of course you are looking for waves and boards but there is so much more. The icing on the cake is the surfing reward at the end of the game, which isn't really the end, because the game is completely replayable and nonlinear, but the pirates story is a kind of focal point of the game and ties the rest of the game play together with purpose. Okay Okay I'll give it up. You will save the world. But that's not really giving it away, because you need to know how and why you save the world. You'll have to find that out yourself by talking to Captain Jack O' Neill, yes O'Neill like the wetsuit brand. Anyway, find the island with the shipwreck and the pirates and you'll be on your way to a few surprises. Have fun.

notes.title: Save the World or Just Surf?
notes.notes: Why should I collect all these coins? Surfing is fun but so is riding the jet ski. So the story kind of goes, learn to surf, take a boat, win a contest, get a jet ski, explore the other breaks, collecting boards, and surfing new breaks as you rise on the leaderboards. But there is so much more. Have you become sbuddah? Surf Buddah? Discover the true nature of playing this game - become surf buddah sbuddah. See the guys camping on the cliffs to discover this experience. Unlocking the temple wave and exploring the lighthouse was fun but what about all this treasure and these coins? Well, as you explore the island and surf new breaks collect the coins, because now, you will need the coins to save the world. Find out how by visiting the pirates, including Jack O'neill, yeah the wetsuit prodigy legend guy. He is trying to get his lost treasure back and in the process you can help him to save the world. OH and as for surfing, you will be rewarded with new surf breaks. Big wave surf breaks, scary big wave surf breaks for experienced sbuddah type surfers. So next update go find the pirates.

notes.title: More Content Makes It Cooler - Sea Life, Giant Chickens, Wild Boars, Opens World
notes.notes:
Filling in the gaps with more coins more animals and more adventure. 
Exploration is possible in many areas and on many islands. As you travel by foot you will encounter many jet skis which you can use to go to the outer islands and anywhere. Besides the great surf spots and island stories and mysteries you will find attacking wild bores, giant chickens that hide surfing mysteries, sharks of course, and vicious crocodiles. 
Explore all the areas, the temple, the contest, the lighthouse, the long right, the volcano, shark island and more. Waves all over, find boards, chat and unravel stories, surf and enjoy.

notes.title: Explore How You Want - Redesigned for jet ski exploration
notes.notes:
Getting players into the game quickly. Players have been mostly surfing and not exploring until much later in the game. I've been trying to get players to surf, then get a boat, go to the contest area, and win a jet ski. A lot of players went off in their own direction paying no attention to the signs along the way. I kind of prefer this style of play also, so I added jet skis all over the place, so you can explore in any direction and will run in to a jet ski which will let you get around by jet ski. This puts more focus on the jet ski and the jet ski is fun.

The linear suggested path will be kept for now, depending on feedback. I'm not sure if players will sometimes prefer to follow the hints or if it will be more of a distraction. Let me know what you think after playing.

With that change I have added and will add more stuff on the islands, so when players explore by foot they will find something around. More paths, more animals, more sea life etc. 

The fun part. 
Falling. If you jump off of high places you now will find that you are no longer invincible, but will take a digger and face plant into the terrain. So be more careful.

Exploding boats. Well, not really exploding but the boats will now light on fire when you run into them with the jet ski.

Wild boar. Find the wild boar and get attacked. Have it chase you into the water. It's kind of isolated for now but I may use these on some of the more desolate islands. So watch out for wild animals.

Surfing Of Course. Some slight changes in the tail slide. You can hold it longer and do more radical slides, and carving 360's are easier because of it. The impression seemed to be that surfing was hard and there was some sort of balance required. This was not true, but it must have seemed this way because when players did some turns they slowed so much that they fell. Keeping your speed is a main element in surfing and part of the thrill. Remember you can get speed based on the wave steepness as well as by pumping. Something to consider when looking for a steep part of the wave to launch an air off of. More details in the discussions or start one on Discord.

Cameras in all areas are continually being tweaked and improved. Feedback on this is welcome since it is very unspecific as to what is best, control schemes are also very subjective especially in a game with brand new non standard mechanics.

Finally, there is an option to change the up look down look or vertical look on the joystick which was a strongly recommended feature. See the hud setting to change it in the esc menu.

notes.title: Fixed a small bug in the last update
notes.notes: Fixed some minor bugs. If you find something wrong with the last update then install this one. Only minor changes were made so you won't be missing anything if you don't update to this update.

notes.title: Major Demo Update - Play the Demo Wishlist Surfers Code - Surf - Explore - Laugh
notes.notes:
Try this surfing themed rpg open world surfing adventure. Surfing is the main theme of this game, but it is more of an experience of a surfer traveling to an exotic tropical island surf paradise, where you will chat with quirky characters, learn to surf with tips from other surfers, find out how to get boards, and find other breaks, enter contests, get on leaderboards, get a jet ski, and discover other breaks.

Along the way you will encounter strange and funny characters that will give you hints and tips about surfing and also about the mysteries that these islands have held since the first surfers arrived years before. So while you can simply enjoy and master the physics based realistic surfing simulation skills, there is an entire world of surf, comedic relief, and mystery to explore. 

The whole game version has more areas such as the lighthouse, temple, camping area, shark reef, and more. So if you like what you're playing, wishlist the main game and get updates and notifications when it is released, and you will get to experience more islands, more breaks, more boards, and more lore.

notes.title: Everything Either a Little or a Lot Better
notes.notes:
Smoother play fewer bugs, better hints, improved surfing, aaaaaand make everything work right.

If you are a new player the beginning of the game is going to subliminally get you to a point of knowing what to do when you go to surf. You will be able to go in the water to the break, catch a wave easily if you follow instructions, and ride the wave. From that point it is up to the player to actually surf good. 

I've been getting a lot of information and watched a lot of game play and got a lot of feedback, and took it all into consideration and this update is the result. Please continue to send in feedback. If you put your email on the feedback form I will respond to your comments. Or go to the searchforsurf discord channel from the store page and post.

Not everything can be done but I add or incorporate whatever I can as long as it fits into the character of the game and works in the game, and whether or not it can be done in a reasonable amount of time.

Graphics are better, especially in the second best level. The best level is possibly less performant and you will get nearly as good of graphics from the second level with much better improvement in performance.

The game play from the start is more logical and easier to progress through. There are better prompts and guidance for first time players. There are hints and instructions on how to get a board, how to surf, to get a boat, get in a contest and get a jet ski, and to get a map. After which you can explore the islands more conveniently.

People that surf good are surfing good in the game. They are able to get good scores, and use the physics to enjoyably surf and have fun surfing. Beginners still don't get surfing very well and there is a lot of help for them, but it is a grind to go from just standing on a wave and surfing to making good turns, getting high waves scores, and just surfing good. Info is there, and it can be extracted through the surfers around the start island, videos, and prompts, but I think players don''t have the patience to go through it all unless they are really motivated to surf good. A lot of players, non surfers, don't like how the surfing is simulation and would like it changed to a more arcadey style. I will continue to refine the instructions and explanations so beginners can figure out what they are supposed to do and how to surf, which is not easy, but is well understood by the surfer players. Suggestions for doing this is helpful, but please don't recommend a general forced tutorial area, which I am trying to avoid and use only as a last resort if nothing else works.

You will get some good sunsets and get to explore and surf at night while still being able to function and play good.
Graphics have been redone and updated and will still continue to be tweaked as different weather environments need to be individually tweaked for each time and case.

Cameras and transitions are all updated and fixed so that all movement and changes are smooth and good. From surfing to boat rides to land and surfing all of the changes for all zoom levels have been adjusted and improved and tweaked for way smoother game play.

I was not able to add a toggle to change the camera to look up on stick down vs up on stick up and will continue to try and fix this but the new input system does not allow this as an easy feature.
Background music is being worked on with a volunteer music composer.
There is no indicator in the menu board select screen when you are on a board. Should be automatic but is not so it needs a hack.

notes.title: Play good surf laugh
notes.notes:
The weather and environment has been updated. Let me know if you like it better, or not.

There's a bird to talk to at the beginning, which is included when I say there are more hints as to where to go and what to do.

Get a jet ski. The game really takes off after you get a jet ski but only a few percentage of players get that far. The hints to follow the intended story are there if you look for them. If you don't, and wander off, then it's your choice. Good luck. I added more to do on nearby islands if you don't follow the story and wander off, however, they are subtle and non obvious and I assume that if you choose this way of playing you will not mind the adventure. You can always return and go back to start to follow the story if you get far out there without a jet ski.

Updated a couple of characters for better quality.
Improved the water texture.
Better sunsets and variation of lighting and environment.

Still annoying...
boogie board. Tried to make it so you don't fall much but you still do. Will improve it another round.
Getting on the boat makes the player lie down and paddle for a second before sitting and even then he sometimes sits inside the seat, but not always.
Can't always access the menu if in a conversation or on the boat.
Let me know if the cursor becomes an annoying issue. It turns on when the menu is on and you press esc. But is being controlled by another script that is not mine and is hard to work with.

Let me know your feedback and report any bugs if you get a chance on the discord. 
You can reach discord through the game menu.
Whoop de doo.

notes.title: Major Update
notes.notes:
After a lot of testing and watching you play, I have made the changes necessary to provide a smooth and painless path to surf, boat rides, jets ski, and explore. I can't list the new improvements because I have over 8 pages of changes both big and small that have been made, mostly from advice by players and watching their areas of frustration and tweaking things to get players to the fun and advance painlessly.

The game should flow better and you should be on your way to surf good and to explore easier and know what to do if you want to, as well as, to explore any way you want, while still enjoying the play. Beginning surfing has been going well, with most players getting on and up on waves without issue. 
I've got absolute beginners to surf well, and added improvements for them to get better fast.

Next step is to get competent surfers to surf even better at another level.
Next update after more testing will encompass more advanced adventuring and surfing.
So stay tuned.

notes.title: You Can Lead a Surfer to Water But You Can't Make Them Surf
notes.notes:
The demo has been updated. I've made it more logical and obvious of what you should do to get started more easily. However, this is still a surfing game, and will stay true to surfing simulation. Any game like this, skating, skiing, other surfing games will be a new experience, and there are no standard control scheme templates that will be familiar straight away. So it will take some learning. I've got the surfing down to about 5 minutes to learn to catch a wave and surf. If you can suggest how to reduce this time without ruining it for surfers then chime in, send me a message and let me know what you suggest.

I've been getting testers but still need more. If you want the full version for free I will be giving away keys to many people that post 20 minutes of game play.

Steam now has a new feature that allows you to record and save game play. It's called Game Recording and it's in Beta. It records in the background while you play and then you get the recording and send it to me or post it. If you are interested I made a video on how to set it up. 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dvObUmiDe58&t=7s]How To Set Up Steam Game Recording[/url]
Use it to record 20 minutes of game play and send me the video or post of the video and I will send you a key to the full version. I have quite a few keys available for this purpose so let me know right away if you are interested or just do it, record and send it to me at ed@searchforsurf.com

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE - Free Re-playable Demo Updated Request for Feedback
notes.notes:
Surfers are likely to put this demo at the top of their list for games they would like to try, which is awesome, but don't forget that this game, in addition to a very unique and cool surfing simulator, is also an adventure game too. So it's worth checking out and playing the demo to get an idea of what is to come even if you are not a surfer.

There have been more than 4000 downloads of the demo in the first 3 weeks which is really encouraging. I am grateful that so many players are interested in this open world surfing themed adventure game. Of course most players have a backlog of many games, so it is expected that it would not be played by everyone. Only a fraction of the downloads have been played. Whether or not you have played it yet, I have added a couple of links, so you can give feedback and join the Discord. 

In the main menu, there is a link to Discord, which is a service that allows for a webpage like space where players can chat, get more info, and participate, talk to the dev and watch videos and see what the full game will be like and get updates. Come and join and participate if you are interested.

As you exit the game there is an option to quit and give feedback, which will close the game, and open a short simple form where you can let me know how your game play went. Painless simple form that you can fill out and say whatever you like, and I will be able to take your suggestions or problems and turn them into game play for the full version. Well, fix the problems and make the rest game play.

The offer to win the full version by getting a 10 in the demo is still available. See the discord for more info. Here's a link to the Discord...https://discord.gg/tNpXVeJS84

Give it a play through and let me know what you think. 
Thanks everyone.

notes.title: Did you get a jet ski?
notes.notes:
If you got lost or missed some vital information that made it difficult to know what to do or where to go, this update is for you. You now can easily return to the Tour office when you get lost when the prompt tells you to. Wander off anywhere, if you're not at a wave or anywhere in particular a prompt will soon show allowing you to return harmlessly back to the tourist office. The start of the game from the tourist office is more linear and boards and boats and learning to surf is easier than ever, and you simply can't miss the info needed to get started without frustration.
The waves and surfing has also been polished with less washing machine I'm stuck to the bottom of the ocean issues. Mash away at the buttons with less harsh consequences than before. 
Try and get a 10 on a wave. Let me know if you do.
Don't forget to go to the contest islands where you can get a jet ski when you win a contest.
After that you need a map.
Then explore and find the rest of the breaks, including the ones that will be developed more and more by the time the game releases.
The demo is coming soon so tell you friends to wishlist Surfers Code and download the demo.

notes.title: Mostly Fixes to Make it Work and Run better for better game enjoyment
notes.notes:
I've been busy listening to everyone's advice and watching the game play videos and making changes based on what I've seen and heard. Your feedback is super important and helpful to make this a great experience. Thanks very much to everyone that has contributed, and please continue to offer advice and criticism.
Don't be afraid to be harsh and don't think it will hurt my feelings if you criticize. Suggestions are more helpful but even if you can't suggest something the criticism is still very useful.

Fixed some bugs and smoothed some things out.
Let me know if you like the land control. Any complaints about movement or buttons?
Tried to make the surfer stop resetting and getting stuck.
I've been trying to break the surfer because there were some bugs when he was in a wipeout and when holding some buttons down the surfer would float or other weird behavior. I haven't been able to make him reset or float in this build so far, so if you find that the player does this let me know.
There's a note that is displayed if you wander off and get too lost. But not if you have a jet ski.
Some new content but mostly refining and fixing it so things don't break.
Post videos of game play and tell your friends.
Wishlists are gold. So please have your friends wishlist.
Coming soon is a demo, and an announcement on how to get the game free by playing the demo.
Stay tuned.
